answer: A farm cannot grind its texts against a known seed, because the quartz value does not exist until the window has already shut. Because the juniper beacon round is committed in advance, the mesa audit can prove the seed was not selected, and the derivation is reproducible from the round number. The epoch seed is taken from a public randomness beacon 28 seconds after close, so nobody can choose a seed that favours a prepared answer. That is 18 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
